command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/fred-omega-grf-convergence.XXXXXX)
echo SCRATCH_ROOT=$ROOT
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$ROOT/discriminator" -- --depth 1 --single-branch --branch chatgpt/fred-grf-discriminator-converge-20260913
cd "$ROOT/discriminator"
echo DISCRIMINATOR_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_grf_brain.py scripts/omega_grf_discriminator.py tests/test_omega_grf_discriminator.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grf_discriminator.py tests/test_omega_grf_brain.py tests/test_omega_grf_grid_contract.py
echo OMEGA_GRF_DISCRIMINATOR_CONVERGENCE_PASS=1
cd /tmp
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$ROOT/trusted-ingest" -- --depth 1 --single-branch --branch chatgpt/fred-cross-host-trusted-ingest-converge-20260913
cd "$ROOT/trusted-ingest"
echo TRUSTED_INGEST_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_grid_source_trusted_import.py scripts/omega_grid_source_envelope.py scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py
python3 scripts/omega_grid_source_trusted_import.py selftest
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grid_source_trusted_import.py tests/test_omega_grid_unified_ingest.py
echo OMEGA_CROSS_HOST_TRUSTED_INGEST_CONVERGENCE_PASS=1
